title: United South pitcher Danyka Charles signs with Texas A&M-Kingsville
excerpt: United South High School pitcher Danyka Charles has signed to play softball at Texas A&M University-Kingsville.
content:
United South High School pitcher Danyka Charles has signed to play softball at Texas A&M University-Kingsville.

Charles signed during the fall signing period, which opened Nov. 11 for NCAA Division II softball. She will join the Javelinas, who compete in the Lone Star Conference at the NCAA Division II level.

The signing was announced Monday, Nov. 17.

Sources: Texas A&M University-Kingsville Athletics (Javelinas, NCAA Division II, Lone Star Conference).
